name: jsettlers-t3-dev-t3
purpose: DEV JSettlers table for the T3 candidate (experiments/tiles-onpolicy-dev2.json): planner_pv2_tiles_t3 alone vs three all-SMART JSettlers 2.6.10 robots, base seed 20261118, 1024 games, paired by game name with the other policy's run.
analysis: Paired by scripts/jsettlers_paired.py --alpha 0.05 --expect-games 1024 --point-bar 0.02; the DEV verdict is 'dev_pass' (experiments/tiles-onpolicy-dev2.json).
limitations: The patch file is GPLv3-derived and lives only in runs/external (never in this repo); its sha256 is pinned here. all_smart makes every locally started robot use JSettlers' SMART strategy params, including our extrabot's inherited fallback brain.
note: Predeclared 2026-11-10 before the T3 offline gate outcome was read and before any game; fresh base seed 20261118; launch with `uv run --with numpy`.
